entityName: COBURG UNIVERSITY OF APPLIED SCIENCES AND ARTS
entityDescription:
Hochschule Coburg is a public university financed by Bavarian State Ministry of Science and the Arts. As the English term “University of Applied Sciences and Arts” suggests, a Hochschule is characterized by practice-related teaching and research as well as a strong practical focus. Its educational philosophy is designed to enable its students to apply their theoretical knowledge and methodological know-how to solving concrete problems in their professional careers. During their studies the students at Coburg University are systematically trained to develop those skills. To make sure that students never lose sight of the practical relevance of what they are learning, both full-time and part-time faculty are required to have gained ample experience in leading positions of business and administration. 

Hochschule Coburg is registered on the Research Map of the German Rectors' Conference with the three research focuses: 1) One Health; 2) Smart Sensing, Automation and Analytics and 3) Sustainable mobility and energy concepts. The three research focuses illustrate the university’s research profile and demonstrate its specific expertise in addressing societal challenges. Researchers from different disciplines come together under the umbrella of a research focus to work on interdisciplinary issues.

entityDescription:
As our slogan "EMC is our thing" suggests, all NEXIO's activities are focused on EMC. 
NEXIO is an EMC Solution Provider with 4 strategic activities : Software, Test Engineering, Simulation and R&D. NEXIO is a major actor in EMC in France with a wide range of software and services for EMC in the civil, automotive, military and aerospace sectors. In 2008, NEXIO began to see the Return on Investment of its 2007 strategy : export and innovation. NEXIO's products are exported to Germany, the US and China and we have distributors in more than 10 countries.
1) EMC Test Software NEXIO has been developing a wide range of software, BAT-EMC, in the aim of automatized EMC tests since 1995. BAT EMC is the leader of of EMC TEST SOFTWARE in France for large company and accredeting test house. Bat-EMC is saling wordwide since 2007.
2) EMC Test Engineering ServicesOur team of specialist engineers and technicians can provide a wide range of EMC services adapted to the different phases of the development of electronic products. From test plans to report management, NEXIO allows you to take advantage of many years of experience with personalized solutions to your specific needs.Know-how : ¿ Sectorial : aerospace, automotive, industrial ¿ Testing : Emissions, Immunity, Lightning-Transient, RF, ¿ Automatic or Manual ¿ Project : EMC methodology and associated technical documentation. 
3) Simulation, analysis and modeling ServicesFrom  conception and development to analysis and validation, our EMC simulation experts and team have the experience and the know-how necessary to provide you with a made to measure solution to your company¿s systems, equipment, component and PCB research and development needs. Systems : ¿  Constraints of lightning and RF fields in conducted and radiated. ¿  On structures, on harnesses, at the Input point of equipment. Equipment : ¿  External EMC : shielding effectiveness, radiated and  conducted emissions ¿  Internal EMC: Signal Integrity, PCB emissions Know-how : ¿ Sectorial : aerospace, automotive, car systems and equipment manufacturers, components manufacturers ¿ Tools : ASERIS (FD, BE, NET, HF), FEKO, Microstripes, CableMod, Spice, EMC-CNES, ¿
4) R&D NEXIO, joined the Aerospace Valley competitiveness cluster in 2006 and are now playing a key role in achieving the ambitious goals set to ensure the competitiveness of the European aerospace industry through a variety of EMC research and development projects in 2 projects: EPEA: The Electromagnetic Compatibility Platform for Embedded Applications (EPEA) project aims to develop a range of EMC engineering resources and measuring methods for the development of simulation models. NEXIO is a leading member of the project along with other specialized companies, research centers, academics and industrial groups. Our EMC simulation and engineering department is working on a variety of work packages covering for example the development of a generic method for modeling the EMC immunity of components, the simulation of equipment emissions and the development of methods of evaluating and validating EMC simulation tools.  PCB², The Passive Component & power on Board in Printed Circuit Boards project aims to develop new Printed Circuit Boards technologies with the objective of improving the performance and reducing the size of embedded electronic calculators. The project is orientated towards PCB technologies offering a high level of physical integration and reliability specific to the domain.  NEXIO ensures the EMC aspects of the project.

entityDescription:
Moniteye are Structural Monitoring Equipment Providers supplying Engineering based Companies unique and specialist Monitoring instrumentation. For the past 6 years Moniteye has developed and deployed cutting edge remote structural monitoring systems in a variety of scenarios including road and rail infrastructure and domestic and commercial buildings. A varied product line has allowed Moniteye to provide accurate data on displacement, levelling and tilt movement to infrastructure managers in a variety of sectors. Utilising the latest in GPRS, GSM and SMS technology allows the recorded data to be transmitted wirelessly from site to our specially developed online gateway. Users can then access this data from

Our areas of expertise include quick deployment of remote structural monitoring solutions on commercial structures and sensitive transport infrastructure assets. We have also worked closely with a number of clients to develop completely bespoke solutions. Our recent projects have included developing a bespoke monitoring instrument to measure the movement of the Thames Barrier to ascertain both the effectiveness of the Barrier's mechanism and the effect that boat strikes and wash have on the structure. Recently deployed 20 of our tilt devices to monitor the movement of a trackside embankment for Network Rail. entityName: NATIONAL INSTITUTE FOR LASER, PLASMA AND RADITION PHYSICS
entityDescription:
The National Institute for Laser, Plasma & Radiation Physics (INFLPR) is an independent, national importance research institution established by the Government of Romania. INFLPR was founded in 1977, with the mission to advance the knowledge in several strategic areas of the sciences and technologies related to laser, plasma, and radiation physics. In 1996 INFLPR was reorganized to include the Institute of Space Sciences (ISS).

The institute employs 447 researchers and administrative staff to conduct frontier research ranging from basic photonic materials and high power lasers, nanomaterials and nanotechnologies, quantum dots and information technologies, plasma physics and X-ray microtomography to industrial photonics, biophotonics and plasma coatings. ISS branch conducts research on astrophysics, space engineering and gravitation

INFLPR is pursuing advanced scientific research funded by national and international agencies, private institutions and enterprises.

INFLPR is currently a member of the EURATOM association, a partner in the Extreme Light Infrastructure (ELI), partner in LASERLAB EUROPE, ALICE, and a leader in many projects funded by the EU, NATO, and other international organizations.

INFLPR's governing body is the Board of Trustees, which is assisted by the INFLPR Director and Board of Directors, and by a Scientific Advisory Board.

The Institute currently consists of six large research departments, the Center for Science Education and Training and ISS branch.

entityDescription:
With a staff of 25 highly qualified people, based in Brussels, Belgium, neXat (previously called SatADSL) is an award-winning, innovative satellite service provider, delivering innovative solutions to satellite operators, teleport & hub operators, governments, enterprise bodies and ISPs. In 2011, NeXat started its business by providing Managed services, i.e. IP connectivity services via satellite to customers in regions where terrestrial infrastructures are absent or unreliable. In 2020, neXat initiated its offering of Cloud-based OSS-BSS, sold in a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) to satellite operators, offering commercially a virtual OSS/BSS with competitive resilience, security and quality features

entityDescription: Micronit Microtechnologies focuses on lab-on-a-chip design, development and fabrication. Micronit is capable of rapid prototyping of microfluidic devices as well as manufacturing them in high volume. The basic material Micronit Microtechnologies uses for its products is mainly glass, but also plastics are used. Glass has so many benefits compared to other materials such as plastics. The glass microfluidic chips go perfectly with the lab-on-a-chip tools, such as a Micronit lab-on-a-chip kit. These microfluidic tools enable you to do your lab-on-a-chip experiments right now; they can be connected to standard lab equipment. From Idea to ProductAt Micronit Microfluidics we understand your research needs, and we have years of experience in translating different needs in several application areas into microfluidic solutions. We focus on keeping the turnaround time for each iteration (idea - prototype - analysis - production - new idea) as short as possible. Application areas we work in are pharmacy (drug discovery), genomics, chemistry, diagnostics, MEMS and many more. Innovation, Quality and VolumeMicronit Microfluidics offers superior chip manufacturing skills, based on many years of quality improvement, process development and supply chain management. Micronit is ISO 9001:2000 and ISO 13485 certified, which ensures our customers to receive the highest possible quality. The synergy of Innovation, Quality and Volume is constantly kept in mind to keep fulfilling the challenging needs of our customers.
